label: ATV Set: Enduro 250, Trike 200, Utility Quad 4x4

camera.projection: flat-facet 3/4, z-buffered, ordered dither (4x4 Bayer), depth-edge darkening, no AA, binary alpha

bake.one_cell: one 256 x 192 cell for all three bodies; model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings at every pose — leaned, parked, on full bump
bake.no_rider: THE BAKE CARRIES NO RIDER. The character rig mounts on anchors(dir, opts): seat, gripL/gripR, pegL/pegR, already posed through steer, suspension and lean.
bake.parked_default: the dirtbike DEFAULTS TO stand 1 — she bakes parked, leaning 12deg to the street side. Every rolling cue sets stand 0. See per_body.dirtbike.painted_bbox.ridden.
bake.facing_note: dir 0 (N) shows the TAIL: the machine points away. dir 4 (S) shows the nose. Street side (-x) reads at NE E SE; curb side at SW W NW. Exhaust curb side, side stand street side.

cues.t_rule: cyclic cues sample t = i/n (frame n wraps to 0); steer and park sample t = i/(n-1), both ends inclusive
cues.stand_rule: roll, turn and bounce set stand 0 themselves; steer does not — the steer sheet is baked with stand 0 passed in

roll.front_scaling: bike and trike: the front wheel is a different radius and turns rR/rF times as fast, so both tread the same road
roll.cyclic: exact — the lug pitch is fitted to a whole number of lugs per revolution; see per_body.*.roll_seam

steer.sense: +1 = full LEFT (nose swings toward -x) — the dually's convention

dirtbike.mechanism: whole front assembly about the raked head axis

trike.mechanism: whole front assembly about the raked head axis

quad.mechanism: bars about a vertical stem; front pair yaw about their own kingpins, Ackermann

steer.coupling: steer, yaw and lean are published together and NOT coupled by the rig; the turn cue couples them for the sheet only

suspension.rule: the BODY moves and pitches, the wheels stay on the ground: dz(y) linear between the axles, applied to every sprung polygon and every SADDLE anchor
suspension.trike_rear: RIGID (travel 0). susR is accepted and ignored; the balloon tires are the springs.

lean.axis: the tyre contact line — world y at x=0, z=0 — so the ground row never moves
lean.sense: +1 leans toward the CURB (+x); cornering leans INTO the turn: steer +1 pairs with lean -1
lean.stacks_with_stand: leanDeg = lean*28 - stand*12; dims().leanDeg publishes the sum and the rider rolls with it

stand.rule: she BAKES PARKED. A dirtbike does not stand upright unridden; the roll/turn/bounce cues set stand 0 and a rider owns the upright state.

yaw.what: heading between the facings. The model turns about z under the fixed key before projection, so the shading is rebaked, not rotated; 45deg at a facing is bit-identical to the next facing.

dirtbike._alt: lamp:false = MX number plate at the same station, no light at night

night.effect: headlamps swap to the glow ramp and spill one pixel; tail lamps do not glow

weather.effect: greys and grimes the plastics, rusts the running gear, speckles

articulation.ramp_budget: 11 ramps at most on any build of any body; the fleet cap is 16

painted_bbox._units: cell px, [x0,y0,x1,y1] inclusive, measured off the alpha channel
painted_bbox._state_note: at_rest IS PARKED (stand 1, leaning 12deg to the street side, lamp). ridden = stand 0, upright. plate = lamp:false, the MX number plate.
painted_bbox.crop_note: pack from union_everything to hold every fitting, pose, yaw step, the lean and the parked attitude in one atlas cell; union_at_rest is the tight default build.

closed_by_rollF.note: roll:1 with rollF = 1 - rR/rF added brings the front round to its start: the seam is the front wheel and nothing else (bit-identical)

roll.why: W — side on, both wheels read

turn.why: SE — nose quarter, street side: steer, yaw and (bike) lean all read

bounce.why: W — side on, the pitch reads

steer.why: S — nose to camera, the front wheel(s) turning read

park.why: SE — the street side, where the stand is

steering.mechanism: the WHOLE front assembly (wheel, fork, fender, lamp, bars) turns about the raked steering axis through the head

lean.note: the contact line is the axis, so the ground row does not move with lean

anchors._units: {x,y} in cell px for that facing, m = [x,y,z] in model metres, already posed
anchors._note: by_facing is PARKED (stand 1, 12deg lean) — the default bake. by_facing_ridden is stand 0, the state a rider mounts into; the character rig wants these.

sheets.pose: PARKED at rest — enduro (teal, weather 0.3, lamp, stand 1: leaning 12deg onto the side stand)
RIDDEN at rest — stand 0, upright. The state a rider mounts into; pool THIS for a moving bike, not the default.
one rear-wheel revolution at W, cyclic (frame 10 wraps to frame 0); stand 0
turn cue at SE, cyclic: steer sin(2pi t), yaw 14deg with it, lean -0.55 into the turn, rolling, stand 0
bounce cue at W, cyclic: susF/susR sin sweep 0.8 out of phase, rolling, stand 0
steer cue at S: full RIGHT lock -> full LEFT lock, 8 inclusive; baked at stand 0 — steering is a ridden act
park cue at SE: stand 0 -> 1, upright -> 12deg onto the stand, 8 inclusive. Run reversed to kick it up.
mxPlate preset — rustOrange, weather 0.22, lamp:false (white MX number plate at the lamp station), parked
the ten harbour paints at SE, weather 0.22, parked
